statement.id: Mereka dikatakan selalu berjalan tegak dan tidak berekor.
statement.en: They are said to walk upright and lack tails.

claims.quote: The nittaewo lived in small parties, and slept in caves or among the branches of trees, in leaf-nests of their own design.

statement.id: Cerita menempatkan mereka dalam kelompok kecil yang tidur di gua atau sarang daun di pohon.
statement.en: Tales place them in small groups sleeping in caves or leaf nests in trees.

claims.quote: The Veddahs themselves were the enemies of the nittaewo, which had no defense against the Veddahs’ bows and arrows.

statement.id: Veddha dikatakan menjadi musuh mereka, dengan busur dan panah yang tak mampu mereka lawan.
statement.en: Veddha are said to be their enemies, armed with bows and arrows they cannot resist.

claims.quote: They did not use tools, instead disembowelling their prey with their long claws or hooked nails, allowing them to feed on the entrails.

statement.id: Mereka tidak memakai perkakas, melainkan membelah perut mangsanya dengan cakar panjang atau kuku melengkungnya sehingga dapat memakan isi perutnya.
statement.en: They used no tools, instead disembowelling their prey with their long claws or hooked nails so they could feed on the entrails.

claims.quote: It was said that whenever a nittaewa came across a sleeping Veddah, it would disembowel them with its claws.

statement.id: Dikatakan bahwa setiap kali seekor nittaewa menjumpai seorang Veddah yang sedang tidur, ia akan membelah perutnya dengan cakar.

claims.quote: The last of the nittaewo were said to have been exterminated by the Veddahs of Leanama during the late 18th century, when they were rounded up into a cave, the entrance of which was then blocked up with brushwood which was set alight, suffocating the trapped nittaewo over three days.

statement.id: Nittaewo terakhir dikatakan dimusnahkan oleh orang Veddah di Leanama pada akhir abad ke-18: mereka digiring ke sebuah gua yang pintunya ditutup semak kering lalu dibakar, sehingga mereka mati lemas selama tiga hari.
statement.en: The last nittaewo were said to have been exterminated by the Veddahs of Leanama in the late 18th century: they were rounded up into a cave whose entrance was blocked with brushwood that was set alight, suffocating them over three days.

short_description.id: Nocnitsa adalah roh atau iblis mimpi buruk dalam mitologi Slavia yang menyiksa orang, terutama anak-anak, pada malam hari.
short_description.en: The nocnitsa is a nightmare spirit or demon of Slavic mythology that torments people, especially children, at night.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, nocnitsa, yang sering disebut dalam bentuk jamak, adalah roh atau iblis mimpi buruk yang menyiksa orang, terutama anak-anak, pada malam hari. Ia juga disebut kriksy, plaksy, atau plachky dalam bahasa Slavia Timur. Nochnitsy adalah roh malam perempuan yang memusuhi manusia; mereka menyerang anak-anak yang hendak tidur sehingga gelisah dan tak bisa tidur, dan bangsa Slavia percaya tangis malam dan tidur yang buruk pada anak adalah ulah mereka.
long_description.en: In Slavic myth the nocnitsa, usually spoken of in the plural, is a nightmare spirit or demon that plagues people, children above all, at night. East Slavic names include kriksy, plaksy and plachky. The nochnitsy are female night spirits hostile to people; they set on children going to sleep, leaving them restless and sleepless, and Slavs blamed children's night crying and poor sleep on them.

long_description.id: Wujudnya beragam menurut daerah: di Serbia timur nenek buruk rupa berbaju hitam, menurut kepercayaan Kroasia perempuan berambut panjang dengan cakar di jari, dan menurut sedikit data Polandia mirip burung atau kelelawar. Di Silesia, nocnica adalah iblis perempuan yang mencekik orang yang tidur, terutama bayi, dan membawa penyakit; ia disebut dalam Katalog Sihir Bruder Rudolf dari abad ke-13.
long_description.en: Its look varies by region: in eastern Serbia an ugly old woman in black, in Croatian belief a long-haired woman with clawed fingers, and in scant Polish data something like a bird or bat. In Silesia the nocnica was a female demon who choked sleepers, especially infants, and brought disease; it is mentioned in Brother Rudolf's 13th-century Catalogue of Magic.

long_description.id: Sebuah artikel menggambarkan nocnica sebagai tokoh demonik yang berakar pada kepercayaan pra-Kristen dan sebagai bentuk keberadaan pascakematian jiwa manusia. Sumber lain menyebut mereka demon perempuan terbang bersayap seperti kelelawar yang muncul pada malam ketika matahari terbenam merah, gemar mengganggu anak-anak dan mendatangkan mimpi buruk. Ahli folklor Jan Broda menggambarkannya berbalut kain putih dan gaun hitam, keluar saat bunyi lonceng gereja dan saat dipanggil dengan siulan; Bohdan Baranowski mencatat bahwa mereka dianggap menyesatkan orang ke tempat tanpa jalan setapak.
long_description.en: One article describes the nocnica as a demonic figure rooted in pre-Christian beliefs and as a posthumous form of existence of the human soul. Another source calls them flying female demons with membranous bat-like wings who appeared on nights when the sun set blood-red, liked to harass children and brought them bad dreams. The folklorist Jan Broda described them in white sheets and black dresses, leaving hiding at the sound of church bells and when whistled for; Bohdan Baranowski reported that they were thought to lead people astray into trackless places.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan umum Slavia, jimat melindungi dari ночница: jarum, pisau, kapak, atau kunci di bawah bantal atau di buaian, juga bawang putih; seorang etnograf mencatat bahwa api melindungi dari mereka. Rumus magis diucapkan terhadap nocnice, dan di Belarus barat dipercaya bahwa начніца dapat berwujud ulat hitam berbulu.
long_description.en: By common Slavic belief amulets protect against the nochnitsa: a needle, knife, axe or key under the pillow or in the cradle, and also garlic; an ethnographer recorded that fire protected against them. Magic formulas were spoken against the nocnice, and in western Belarus it was believed that the načnica could take the form of a black hairy worm.

statement.id: Terhadap nocnice diucapkan rumus magis; ketika matahari terbenam merah, seorang ibu memanggil agar mereka tidak mengunjungi anaknya.
statement.en: Magic formulas were spoken against the nocnice; when the sun set in a red glow, a mother called out to prevent their visit.

claims.quote: Согласно общеславянским верованиям, от ночницы могут защитить обереги. Оберегом могут служить острые металлические предметы, такие как игла, нож, топор, или же ключ, положенные под подушку или в колыбель.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan umum Slavia, jimat melindungi dari ночница: benda logam tajam seperti jarum, pisau, atau kapak, atau kunci, diletakkan di bawah bantal atau di buaian.
statement.en: By common Slavic belief amulets protect against the nochnitsa: sharp metal objects such as a needle, knife or axe, or a key, placed under the pillow or in the cradle.

claims.quote: Надёжную защиту от ночницы дают головки чеснока и другие растения, наделённые в народных представлениях свойством отпугивать нечистую силу.

statement.id: Kepala bawang putih dan tumbuhan lain yang menurut kepercayaan rakyat mengusir kekuatan najis memberi perlindungan yang andal terhadap ночница.
statement.en: Heads of garlic and other plants thought to repel unclean forces give reliable protection against the nochnitsa.

claims.quote: Согласно записям этнографа Богдановича А. Е. от ночниц оберегал огонь.

statement.id: Menurut catatan seorang etnograf, api melindungi dari ночница.
statement.en: According to an ethnographer's records, fire protected against the nochnitsy.

claims.quote: В западной Белоруссии (Слонимский повет) верили, что начніца могла принять вид чёрного мохнатого червяка.

statement.id: Di Belarus barat (Slonimskii povet) dipercaya bahwa начніца dapat berwujud ulat hitam berbulu.
statement.en: In western Belarus (Slonim district) it was believed that the načnica could take the form of a black hairy worm.

claims.quote: Nocnica – postać demoniczna z zakresu demonologii słowiańskiej, wywodząca się z wierzeń przedchrześcijańskich, określana jako pośmiertna forma egzystencji ludzkiej duszy.

statement.id: Nocnica adalah tokoh demonik dalam demonologi Slavia yang berasal dari kepercayaan pra-Kristen dan digambarkan sebagai bentuk keberadaan pascakematian jiwa manusia.
statement.en: The nocnica is a demonic figure of Slavic demonology, rooted in pre-Christian beliefs and described as a posthumous form of existence of the human soul.

claims.quote: Bohdan Baranowski podał ponadto, że przypisywano im zwodzenie ludzi, wyprowadzanie ich na bezdroża, na których musieli długo błądzić, uniemożliwiając lub utrudniając im odnalezienie drogi.

statement.id: Bohdan Baranowski mencatat bahwa nocnice dianggap menyesatkan orang dan menuntunnya ke tempat tanpa jalan setapak sehingga lama tersesat dan sulit menemukan jalan.
statement.en: Bohdan Baranowski reported that nocnice were thought to mislead people and lead them into trackless country where they wandered long, making it hard to find the way.

claims.quote: Folklorysta Jan Broda opisywał je jako złośliwe demony płci żeńskiej ubrane w białe płachty i czarne suknie, pojawiające się nocami, głównie na bezdrożach (zwłaszcza w okresie adwentu) i wychodzące ze swych kryjówek na dźwięk kościelnych dzwonów, a także po przywołaniu gwizdem.

statement.id: Ahli folklor Jan Broda menggambarkan mereka sebagai demon perempuan yang jahat berbalut kain putih dan gaun hitam, muncul pada malam hari terutama di tempat tanpa jalan setapak, keluar dari persembunyian saat bunyi lonceng gereja dan saat dipanggil dengan siulan.
statement.en: The folklorist Jan Broda described them as malicious female demons in white sheets and black dresses, appearing at night mainly in trackless places, leaving their hiding places at the sound of church bells and when summoned by whistling.

short_description.id: North Shore Monster ("Old Briney") adalah makhluk bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda yang konon menghuni Great Salt Lake, Utah [north-shore-monster-c01, north-shore-monster-c02].
short_description.en: The North Shore Monster ("Old Briney") is a crocodile-bodied, horse-headed creature said to inhabit the Great Salt Lake, Utah [north-shore-monster-c01, north-shore-monster-c02].

long_description.id: North Shore Monster, juga disebut "Old Briney", konon menghuni Great Salt Lake di Utah [north-shore-monster-c01] dan paling sering digambarkan bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda [north-shore-monster-c02]. Penampakan paling terkenal terjadi pada 8 Juli 1877 oleh J.H. McNeil dan pekerja tambang garam [north-shore-monster-c03], yang memperkirakan panjangnya sekitar 75 kaki [north-shore-monster-c04]. Deseret News meragukan laporan itu [north-shore-monster-c05].
long_description.en: The North Shore Monster, or "Old Briney", reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah [north-shore-monster-c01] and is most often described with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head [north-shore-monster-c02]. The best-known sighting was on July 8, 1877, by J.H. McNeil and saltworks workers [north-shore-monster-c03], who estimated it at about 75 feet [north-shore-monster-c04]. The Deseret News was sceptical [north-shore-monster-c05].

long_description.id: Menurut kisah yang dicatat Deseret News, McNeil dan beberapa pria lain yang bekerja di tambang garam Barnes and Company dekat Monument Point mendengar raungan yang menakutkan pada awal Juli 1877 [north-shore-monster-c06]. Mereka kemudian melihat makhluk bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda yang menyerbu ke arah mereka, sehingga mereka lari ke pegunungan [north-shore-monster-c07]. Menurut catatan lain, batu-batu besar yang terbalik menandai jejaknya [north-shore-monster-c09].
long_description.en: According to the story recorded by the Deseret News, McNeil and several other men working at the Barnes and Company saltworks near Monument Point heard a frightful bellow in early July 1877 [north-shore-monster-c06]. They then saw a creature with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head that charged toward them, and they fled to the mountains [north-shore-monster-c07]. According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked its trail [north-shore-monster-c09].

long_description.id: McNeil menandatangani afidavit atas kisah itu, dan beritanya dimuat di Corinne Record serta kemudian di Deseret News [north-shore-monster-c08]. Sebagian orang percaya monster itu mungkin seekor kerbau [north-shore-monster-c10].
long_description.en: McNeil signed an affidavit of the account, and the story appeared in the Corinne Record and later in the Deseret News [north-shore-monster-c08]. Some believe the monster may have been a buffalo [north-shore-monster-c10].

role.id: Makhluk yang dilaporkan menyerbu para pekerja tambang garam.
role.en: The creature reportedly charged at the saltworks workers.

summary.id: Para pekerja mendengar raungan, melihat makhluk bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda, lalu lari ke pegunungan [north-shore-monster-c06, north-shore-monster-c07].
summary.en: The workers heard a bellow, saw a crocodile-bodied, horse-headed creature, and fled to the mountains [north-shore-monster-c06, north-shore-monster-c07].

description.id: Danau di Utah yang konon dihuninya.
description.en: The Utah lake it reportedly inhabits.

description.id: J.H. McNeil dan pekerja tambang garam bertemu makhluk besar dekat Monument Point.
description.en: J.H. McNeil and saltworks workers met a large creature near Monument Point.

claims.quote: The North Shore Monster, sometimes referred to as "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.

statement.id: North Shore Monster, kadang disebut "Old Briney", konon menghuni Great Salt Lake di Utah.
statement.en: The North Shore Monster, sometimes called "Old Briney," reportedly inhabits the Great Salt Lake in Utah.

claims.quote: Descriptions of the monster vary, but it is most commonly described as having a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse.

statement.id: Gambarannya beragam, tetapi paling sering bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda.
statement.en: Descriptions vary, but it is most often described with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head.

claims.quote: The most well-known sighting occurred on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and other workers at the Barnes and Co. saltworks near Monument Point on the lake's northern shore claimed to have encountered a large creature

statement.id: Penampakan paling terkenal terjadi pada 8 Juli 1877, ketika J.H. McNeil dan pekerja tambang garam dekat Monument Point mengaku bertemu makhluk besar.
statement.en: The best-known sighting was on July 8, 1877, when J.H. McNeil and saltworks workers near Monument Point claimed to meet a large creature.

claims.quote: McNeil estimated the creature to be about 75 feet long.

statement.id: McNeil memperkirakan panjang makhluk itu sekitar 75 kaki.
statement.en: McNeil estimated it at about 75 feet long.

claims.quote: However, the Deseret News suggested that the report should be taken "with a few grains of salt."

statement.id: Namun Deseret News menyarankan agar laporan itu tidak dipercaya begitu saja.
statement.en: However, the Deseret News suggested taking the report "with a few grains of salt."

claims.quote: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July of 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.

statement.id: J.H. McNeil dari Kelton, Box Elder County, dan beberapa pria lain bekerja untuk tambang garam Barnes and Company di tepi utara dekat Monument Point dan jalur kereta Central Pacific pada awal Juli 1877 ketika mereka mendengar raungan yang menakutkan.
statement.en: J.H. McNeil of Kelton, Box Elder County, and several other men were working for the Barnes and Company saltworks on the northern shore near Monument Point and the Central Pacific railroad line in early July 1877 when they heard a frightful bellow.

claims.quote: As McNeil tells it, they looked up and saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and the head of a horse. As it saw the men, it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.

statement.id: Menurut penuturan McNeil, mereka melihat makhluk mengerikan bertubuh mirip buaya dan berkepala kuda; ketika makhluk itu melihat para pria, ia menyerbu ke arah mereka dan mereka lari ke pegunungan.
statement.en: As McNeil tells it, they saw an awful creature with a crocodile-like body and a horse's head; when it saw the men it charged toward them and they fled to the mountains.

claims.quote: McNeil signed an affidavit of the account, and a story on the sighting was published in the Corinne Record and later the Deseret News.

statement.id: McNeil menandatangani afidavit atas kisah itu, dan berita tentang penampakan tersebut dimuat di Corinne Record lalu di Deseret News.
statement.en: McNeil signed an affidavit of the account, and a story on the sighting was published in the Corinne Record and later in the Deseret News.

claims.quote: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.

statement.id: Menurut catatan lain, batu-batu besar yang terbalik menandai jejak makhluk yang mengamuk itu.
statement.en: According to another account, huge overturned boulders marked the trail of the marauding beast.

claims.quote: Some believe the monster may have been a buffalo.

statement.id: Sebagian orang percaya bahwa monster itu mungkin seekor kerbau (bison).
statement.en: Some believe the monster may have been a buffalo.

short_description.id: Nisroch adalah dewa Asyur yang dalam artikel disebut disembah Sennacherib.
short_description.en: Nisroch is an Assyrian deity worshipped by Sennacherib according to the article.

long_description.id: Nisroch adalah dewa Asyur yang dalam artikel disebut disembah Sennacherib. Artikel mencatat nama Nisroch dalam 2 Raja-raja 19:37 dan Yesaya 37:38.
long_description.en: Nisroch is an Assyrian deity worshipped by Sennacherib according to the article. The article records Nisroch in 2 Kings 19:37 and Isaiah 37:38.

long_description.id: Artikel menghubungkan nama Nisroch dengan arti elang besar. 2 Raja-raja menempatkan ibadah raja di rumah dewa Nisroch. Dalam episode ibadah itu, Adrammelech dan Sharezer membunuh raja dengan pedang. Dalam episode yang sama, Esarhaddon kemudian menjadi pengganti raja.
long_description.en: The article connects the name Nisroch with the meaning great eagle. Second Kings places the king’s worship in the house of the god Nisroch. In that worship episode, Adrammelech and Sharezer kill the king with a sword. In the same episode, Esarhaddon succeeds the king as ruler.

long_description.id: Nisroch kemudian muncul dalam demonologi dan sastra: Dictionnaire infernal karya Collin de Plancy menjadikannya iblis tingkat kedua dan kepala juru masak Beelzebub, dan Paradise Lost karya John Milton menampilkannya sebagai malaikat pemberontak. Austen Henry Layard pernah mengidentifikasi relief berkepala elang dari Nimrud sebagai Nisroch, tetapi relief itu tidak ada pada zaman Sanherib.
long_description.en: Nisroch later appears in demonology and literature: Collin de Plancy's Dictionnaire infernal makes him a second-rank demon and Beelzebub's head cook, and John Milton's Paradise Lost presents him as a rebel angel. Austen Henry Layard once identified an eagle-headed relief from Nimrud as Nisroch, but it did not exist in Sennacherib's time.

items.catatan_sebelumnya: Name meaning great eagle does not establish an eagle body or iconography.
items.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Nisroch, the eagle-headed Assyrian deity.
ANATOMY: ONE eagle head with two natural raptor eyes and hooked beak, short feathers, on ONE fully covered humanoid body. TWO arms with five fingers per hand; legs under long opaque plain robe. No wings, horns, crown, weapon, pail, pinecone or uncertain relief attributes. Eagle head in original quote c01. [nisroch-c01, nisroch-c02]
MOMENT: Step from a dark temple threshold toward the viewer, lowering his great eagle head while an open hand extends in authoritative command.
POWER: No documented power. No magical effects or destruction; reverent awe from eagle-headed identity, imposing close approach and light. [nisroch-c01]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extremely close low camera; eagle face and commanding hand fill frame, no invented cosmic scale. Distinguishing features readable at200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE warm low directional light source from sky slit, temple door or offcamera lamplight appropriate to setting; hard rim light, deep walnut shadows and antique gold accents. Physical dust or water only from contact. Dark high contrast.
SURFACE: Natural tactile material appropriate to subject: rough woven cloth, wet scales, tangled hair, feather barbs and coarse stone, never plastic.
SETTING: House/temple of Nisroch where Sennacherib worshipped, plain unmarked dark stone. [nisroch-c04]
MOOD: Dangerous imposing menace or respectful ancestral/divine awe as appropriate. Subject dominates and moves toward viewer, never cute, calm, ordinary human/animal snapshot or static pose.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native square PNG minimum1024. No text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark. Exact sourced anatomy, no extra heads, limbs, fingers or attributes. No film/game/anime/comic design. Fully opaque clothing for human torso and hips, no nudity or explicit gore. No generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes or invented powers.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.
